title: SPRING & DIFF. MOUNTING BRACKET
summary: Rear transverse leaf spring and the differential mounting bracket, all models. The spring center is clamped to the underside of the differential carrier by a plate and bolts from below; each spring end is attached to the spindle support (rear knuckle/trailing arm) by a long link bolt with rubber cushions and retainers above and below, a nut and cotter pin. The differential mounting bracket bolts to the carrier with two bolts, nuts and cotter pins.

parts.name: BOLT
parts.name_expanded: Bolt – spring center plate to differential carrier

parts.name: MOUNTING BRKT.
parts.name_expanded: Mounting bracket – differential carrier front mount

fastening.note: Bolts [7] with lock washers [6] go up from below through plate [5] and the spring center into the differential carrier. Note B: torque with spring compressed to design height.

Link bolt [1] goes down from the top through retainer [2] and cushion [3] at the spindle support arm, then through the spring end; below the spring: retainer [14], cushion [3], retainer [2], nut [13], cotter pin [12]. Retainers [2]: rounded side toward cushion. Nut [13]: only the torque needed to line up the cotter pin hole (note D).
Bolts [8] go through the bracket [9] and the carrier lugs, inserted from the direction shown (note A); nuts [10] torqued plus extra to line up the cotter pin holes, then cotter pins [11].
Note C: retainer [14] is peened over the spring end at assembly.

notes: NOTE: Place rounded side toward cushion.
A: Must be assembled from direction shown.
B: Must be torqued with spring compressed to design height.
C: Peen over spring at asm. & maintain .?00 min. dia. after peening.
D: Only necessary torque required to line-up Cotter Pin Hole.
Plus additional torque to line-up C. Pin hole.
